0:
Hm? Sugata-senpai, what're you doing?
Staring into the water like that.
1:
Ah, there seem to be more fish than I
expected, so I thought I would catch some.
2:
Huh... But we're having a barbecue for
lunch, right?
4:
I need to catch tonight's share while it is
still light out.
5:
Still living that hardcore survival tent life,
huh?
6:
But even if you're fishing, did you bring a
fishing rod or anything?
7:
With water this clear, there is no need for
a fishing rod.
8:
Sure, the water's so clean you can see the
bottom... but what's that got to do with
anything?
9:
If you are interested, would you like to
watch?
12:
(Senpai's standing in the shallows, not
moving a muscle...)
14: I will show you now. Stay quiet, understood?
20:
He caught a fish with his bare hands?!
Awesome!! He's like a bear!!
22:
That's amazing, Senpai! I've never seen
anybody catch a fish without any gear
before!
23:
I saw a bear doing it, so I gave it a try. It is
surprisingly doable.
24:
A bear has the arm strength, so it can
just swat the water and all...
25:
A human lacks the arm strength, so you
thrust your hand straight in like a blade
and yank it back out.
26:
...I don't think normal people can do that
either.
27:
Is that so? Once you get the knack, I think
you could manage it. Would you like to try,
Tomoki?
30:
I doubt I can do it like you, Senpai, but it
looks fun, so I'll give it a shot!
31:
I see. Then step into the water, slowly and
quietly.
33:
Once you are standing in the water, wait
without moving. If you stay still, the fish
stop minding you and eventually come right
up to you.
35:
When a fish comes within reach, thrust
your hand in fast.
37:
Don't rush, don't make noise. Wait
patiently.
43: So it seems. Was it difficult?
45:
That's the spirit, Tomoki. Very well, I will
fish alongside you.
46:
I knew it... a normal human just... CAN'T DO
IT!!
47:
And you, on the other hand, caught a whole
bunch, Senpai...
48: Yes, I have secured enough for dinner.
50: You get used to it, and it works out.
51:
There's no way I can do it without gear. I
didn't catch a single one in the end...
You're just not normal, Senpai!
52:
Let's make it a contest, Sugata-senpai!
Whoever catches the most wins!
54: I'll get into the water too... there.
55:
This must be your first time catching fish
like this. Do you want a few practice runs?
56: Nah, I'll be fine. Let's catch a ton!
57:
Then let us set a time limit. Whoever
catches more in that time wins.
63: Ah, n-nothing... That one was just practice!
64: I see. I won't go easy on you, you know.
68:
Whoa. He's seriously catching fish with his
bare hands... Damn, I can't lose to that!
69: Daaamn, I didn't catch a single one!!
70:
Hm... A fine haul. Enough not just for
dinner, but to preserve as well.
72:
How can you catch fish with your bare
hands?! There's definitely something wrong
with you!
74: Now then... let us bleed them.
76:
If you drain a fish's blood right after
catching it, it stays fresh.
78: Whoa...?! Blood! The fish is bleeding!
79:
It may come as a shock the first time you
see it. Once you're used to it, it's nothing.
80:
Would you like to try, Tomoki? We can make
it a contest, if you like.
82: Going home with nothing but losses, then...
84: Argh!! Fine, you win! Lend me the knife!
90:
Well done. Looks like you could manage life
in a tent too, Tomoki.
91: No thanks, I'm a normal person!
92:
(Sugata-senpai's face looks the same as
always, but... wait, did he just praise me?)
